title: Viking War Horn (Gjallarhorn)
blurb: In Norse myth the Gjallarhorn belongs to Heimdall and sounds to announce the end of the world, which is quite a lot of pressure for a stadium tradition to live up to. Minnesota's crowd ritual popularised the blast, and it promptly outgrew football altogether. The internet now uses it for any epic mobilisation, sincere or otherwise. Play it before raids, road trips, group orders arriving, and the moment somebody finally agrees to leave the house. Skol. The horde is assembled, the horde is ready, and the horde has already checked the parking.
origin: The Viking war horn, famous from Minnesota's stadium tradition.
